title: Cicada 3301 as an intelligence recruitment puzzle

tellings.quote: And a lot of people think that the whole puzzle was set up by the NSA or CIA and it was like a recruitment tool.

plain: Cicada 3301, a series of hard, anonymous puzzles posted online, is said by many to have been set up by the NSA, the US electronic spying agency, or the CIA, its foreign intelligence agency, to recruit talented code breakers. Michels repeats this himself as what "a lot of people think", without naming a source. If true, spy agencies were using a public internet game to find new staff.
